functional_requirements.text: Compute C = A x B for INT4 signed operands, tiled 16x16, arbitrary M,K,N via software tiling.
Accumulate products in a 32-bit signed accumulator (no overflow for K up to ~1e3+).
Apply one per-output-channel scale factor (dequant/requant) -> 8-bit signed output.
Host loads weights+activations into on-chip SRAM over a memory-mapped bus, writes START, reads DONE, reads results.
Softmax / normalization are OUT of scope (host CPU).
Hard-wired datapath; only tile dimensions M/K/N, scale, start/status are register-configurable.
Expose ready/done status pins + done interrupt.

non_functional.text: Active power < 0.5 W; far more efficient per-MAC than host CPU.
Open free PDK (sky130), chipIgnite-class die, per-chip cost low hundreds USD.
Clock 50 MHz; latency 'sub-second for common ops' via 256-wide parallelism.
